files.description:
Sudden boom of distant thunder. Short and subtle. Makes for good storm background noise or as part of a large explosion's reverberation.

A bit low quality and is intended to be played at a low volume.

Recorded with a H4n Pro (built-in mics) 16/10/2019
Edited with Audacity (v2.3.2) 22/07/2021
